name: Atlas-Agena B
tagline: Launched the Ranger lunar probes and Mariner 2 to Venus
description: An Atlas first stage with a Lockheed-built Agena B upper stage. It first flew on an Atlas on 1961-07-12, with Midas 3. Between 1961 and 1965 it completed 21 successes in 28 flights for NASA and the Department of Defense, carrying Ranger lunar probes, Mariner Venus flybys including Mariner 2, Samos reconnaissance satellites and Midas early-warning satellites. The standardized Agena D first flew in 1963 and succeeded it.
best_known_for: Launched the Ranger lunar probes and Mariner 2 to Venus
